title: Sun is 400 times larger and 400 times farther away than the moon

tellings.quote: The sun is 400 times larger than the moon and 400 times farther away.

plain: The Sun is said to be 400 times larger than the Moon and also 400 times farther away, so the two look the same size in the sky. A researcher named Randall Carlson says this on the show, without naming a source, in an episode on the idea that the Moon is artificial. He offers it as a coincidence too neat to be chance.
